lessons.failure: Unmodified source identity test failed in both the selected run and isolated repeat. Diagnostic worker could not read its own /proc/43/stat (ENOENT); a standalone Node process could read its own stat.
lessons.positive_method: Preflight identity visibility in the actual worker context; retain typed unavailability and block ownership-dependent execution without bypassing it.
lessons.inheritance: Worker readiness must become blocked or context-limited when its own ownership evidence is inaccessible. Candidate only; no automatic promotion.

lessons.failure: REA retains the primary typed error together with cleanup diagnostics; live owner release changes outstanding cleanup without erasing history.
lessons.positive_method: Model failure and cleanup as separate owned facts and preserve both across projection.
lessons.inheritance: User-visible primary failure returns after confirmed cleanup; unresolved resources remain blockers. Candidate only; no automatic promotion.

lessons.failure: REA completion ledgers authenticate record ordering, IDs and counts and keep fail/unknown/unsupported/truncated separate from pass.
lessons.positive_method: Recompute derived summaries and reject contradictory serialized status fields.
lessons.inheritance: A forged complete field is rejected; nonpass claims keep readiness open. Candidate only; no automatic promotion.

lessons.failure: REA validates records and candidate bundles before committing additions; conflicting content fails while prior ledger state remains intact.
lessons.positive_method: Authenticate identity at ingestion, seal retained data, and stage an import before changing durable consumer state.
lessons.inheritance: Conflicting input must not partially change the prior ledger. Candidate only; no automatic promotion.

lessons.failure: REA unknown records carry supporting/contradicting evidence, authority requirements, predecessor revisions and explicit resolution.
lessons.positive_method: Preserve uncertainty as revisioned first-class state with resolution evidence.
lessons.inheritance: An unresolved or contradicted question continues to restrict dependent conclusions. Candidate only; no automatic promotion.

lessons.failure: REA proof authority distinguishes unit, native ABI, live process and other boundaries; unit evidence cannot stand in for native proof.
lessons.positive_method: Compare evidence authority against the specific obligation, not a single stronger/weaker ranking.
lessons.inheritance: An incompatible proof leaves the obligation open. Candidate only; no automatic promotion.

lessons.failure: REA obligation evaluation carries ownership/dependency graphs, orphan bindings, limitations and diagnostics; no candidates cannot establish closure.
lessons.positive_method: Keep expected obligations, actual evidence and dependency blockers distinct; make missing obligations visible.
lessons.inheritance: Unsupported/contradictory obligations or incomplete generation prevent a blanket closure claim. Candidate only; no automatic promotion.

lessons.failure: REA setup reports each client outcome even after earlier failure and retains rollback destination/backup information.
lessons.positive_method: Continue independent safe work while retaining each failed stage and recovery instruction.
lessons.inheritance: Mixed setup returns needs_human while retaining successful actions and failed destinations. Candidate only; no automatic promotion.

lessons.failure: REA redacts explicitly sensitive values from exported typed failures while retaining error type and relevant diagnostics.
lessons.positive_method: Keep safe projections separate from protected raw custody, preserving enough typed information for recovery.
lessons.inheritance: Export can hide a marked literal without losing cleanup requirements or retryability. Candidate only; no automatic promotion.
